message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "escalate_to_report_on_ambiguous_classification", "description": "When chest X-ray classifier scores are non-diagnostic (no finding > 0.8) but clinical suspicion remains, invoke the report generator to detect subtle morphological signs.", "applicable_conditions": "Chest imaging interpretation tasks where automated classification yields low-confidence or ambiguous results for complex presentations.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns no strong findings (all scores ≤ 0.8) in a complex clinical scenario: (1) Do NOT rely solely on visual inspection or external context (e.g., CT history) for final diagnosis; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to perform a detailed morphological analysis for subtle signs (e.g., effusion, mediastinal widening); (3) Synthesize the generated report with clinical context for the final assessment."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
